text:
maria: Kicking off the eu-central-2 bring-up thread. We need GPU quota, a small safety cushion for the first 72h, and a network priming window. Can we coordinate?

leo: thumbs up. Proposed plan: request quota for 20 H100-equivalent GPUs, reserve 10 as a soft cushion (not always-on) + 10 active for bootstrapping. autoscale fallback to older A800 pool if H100 spikes.

ada: @leo I'll start the formal cloud quota request. Need the project IDs and cost center tags. maria can you confirm cost center and desired start/end times for the reservation window?

maria: cost center = infra-eu, project = rw-eu-prod, reservation window = 2026-04-06T08:00Z -> 2026-04-09T08:00Z (72h). Cushion should be billed to reservation but flagged as "standby" to avoid steady-state costs when unused.

procurement-bot: Automated note: quota request template: 
```
Provider: GCP
Region: europe-central2
Resource: accelerator.googleapis.com/accelerator_types/H100
Requested delta: +20
Project: rw-eu-prod
Business case: new cluster bring-up + initial validation and stress tests
Dates: 2026-04-06 -> 2026-04-09
```

leo: Adding network priming steps: pre-create VPC peering, route advertising, and health-checks for the subnet. Jamie please validate ipAM ranges (we need contiguous /20 for nodepools). Also enable BFD on the raw router for faster failover.

jamie: I can pre-assign /20 10.240.32.0/20 for worker pools. One ask: ensure we use low-latency placement groups for the first 10 active nodes. I'll add the config snippet to the ops repo.

maria: Also want a quick smoke test matrix during the kickoff hour: 1) node boot + gpu detection, 2) nvpeerlist check, 3) KV cache warmup sample, 4) sample 1k-token generation p95 latency. Keep each run under 5m.

leo: Good. I'll hand off validation to oncall after the 72h window. Handoff checklist (short):
- quotas confirmed and visible in console
- reservation tags attached to billing account
- basic network primed and BFD active
- nodes able to pull container images
- perf smoke tests green
- rollout plan for model variants

karen: I'll take oncall handoff. Please ping me when smoke tests are green. Also include escalation play: if H100 supply is constrained we fallback to A800 with quantized model profiles.

ada: Cost note: if cushion stays unused beyond 12h we auto-release to avoid long running idle charges. Need approval for auto-release policy from finance. @maria can you confirm?

maria: Confirmed, finance OK with 12h auto-release. Tagging policy: reservation:eu-central2:rw-eu-prod and note: "72h bring-up with 12h cushion auto-release".

leo: Quick commands for validation (put in runbook):
```
# check GPUs on node
kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep gpu
ssh gpu-node-01 'nvidia-smi -L && sudo nv_peer_memory_sysfs.sh'
# run perf smoke
kubectl run perf --image=rw/perf:latest --rm -it -- /bin/bash -c 'python smoke.py --tokens 1000'
```

sre-bot: cluster-quota-watch: current quota H100=0, pending request +20, hard-limit window=2026-04-06T08:00Z. Will poll every 15m and post updates here.

jamie: One more networking caveat: cloud load balancer in eu-central2 is on older infra; we should avoid central LB during initial tests and use nodePort -> nginx pod for ingress to isolate LB config changes.

maria: noted. final ask: can procurement mark the reservation with "bring-up-priority" and include a short justification doc? ada?

ada: Yep — I'll attach the justification doc and request priority queueing. Expect provider ack in 24-48h. I'll post the update from the quota portal here.

procurement-bot: Update: quota request submitted (ticket GCP-48721). Estimated review ETA: 36h.

leo: Great. I'll create the runbook entry and link it here when ready. Plan to do a dry-run in staging this week (same steps, smaller GPU counts).

maria: perfect — thanks everyone. :rocket:
